gaps.title: Persistent Document Comments and Update Requests
gaps.jtbd: When viewing a document in the Knowledge Base, I want to submit persistent comments and update requests, so that I can collaborate with others on content revisions.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a document exists in the Knowledge Base, When a user submits a comment or update request, Then the data should be saved to the database and associated with that document.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: Section 4 'Работа с контентом' explicitly asks for commenting and sending update requests ('возможность комментирования и отправки запросов на актуализацию') on documents.

gaps.title: Persistent Search Queries and Favorites
gaps.jtbd: When using the Knowledge Base, I want to save search queries and mark materials as favorites, so that I can quickly access them in subsequent sessions.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an authenticated user, When they save a query or add a document to favorites, Then the preference must be persisted in the database and retrieved on next login.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: Section 4 'Поиск и навигация' explicitly asks for the ability to save search queries and favorite materials ('возможность сохранения поисковых запросов и избранных материалов').

gaps.title: Fuzzy Search and Typo Tolerance
gaps.jtbd: When I enter search queries with typos or spelling errors, I want the system to understand my intent and find relevant documents, so that the search experience is robust and helpful.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given the search query contains spelling errors (e.g. 'Эпидемология'), When the search is executed, Then the system should employ fuzzy matching or spell correction and return relevant documents.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: Section 4 'Поиск и навигация' explicitly asks for typo correction ('исправление опечаток') in search operations.

gaps.title: Dynamic Document Export to PDF and DOCX
gaps.jtbd: When viewing materials in the Knowledge Base, I want to export and download them as formatted PDF or DOCX files, so that I can easily print or read them offline.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a structured document, When a user clicks export to PDF or DOCX, Then the backend should dynamically generate and serve a formatted PDF/DOCX file containing the document content.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: Section 4 'Интеграции и экспорт' explicitly asks for document exporting to PDF/DOCX ('выгрузка документов в PDF/DOCX').

gaps.title: User Authentication and Secure Session Management
gaps.jtbd: When accessing the Knowledge Base, I want my identity to be securely authenticated and my session managed, so that unauthorized users cannot access sensitive blocks or spoof roles.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a user on the login screen, When they provide valid credentials, Then a secure session token (JWT) is generated and validated on all subsequent requests, preventing header spoofing.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: Standard security practices for multi-role educational portals require actual, validated login and session authorization to prevent header-based role spoofing (X-User-Role).

gaps.title: Search and List Pagination
gaps.jtbd: When viewing a long list of search results, I want the results to be paginated, so that system resource consumption and frontend load times are optimized.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a search query with many results, When the query is executed, Then the backend should return results in paginated pages using page number and size parameters.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: A document repository standardly requires list/search pagination to ensure optimal performance, low latency, and efficient database querying.
